Thanks for helping keep the wiki accurate. A factual correction is the one thing I always want reported here. For questions, suggestions, or talking about the project, please reach out directly instead (see the contact links above).

**What is wrong?**
A clear description of the inaccuracy or broken link.

**Where is it?**
Link to the affected page, or the file path in the repo.

**What should it say instead?**
The correct information.

**Source**
A link to the original paper, official documentation, or other authoritative source, if you have one. This helps me verify and fix it quickly.
